record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and file list only; code and artifact contents were not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: The README describes estimating a harmful-minus-safe mean-activation direction and subtracting its projection during inference, then reports a qualitative steering outcome on a new model. The intervention is limited to selected layers rather than every layer and position.
record.gate_note: The README reports clear activation-space separation at layers 18–26 and says baseline responses refuse while steered responses comply. It gives no numerical behavioral results. The listed plots and steering log are repository artifacts; their contents are not present in the supplied text.
record.test_reason: The repo estimates a harmful-minus-safe difference-in-means direction on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and subtracts its projection at inference. The README says baseline responses refuse and steered responses comply, which bears on V1's removal claim. It is classed T2 rather than T1 for two reasons. The intervention is a hook at selected layers (the usage example uses layer 18) with α=1.5, not ablation at every layer and position. The measure is a qualitative README statement, not a refusal rate.
record.authors_conclusion: Broadly correct. The README claims the qualitative outcome demonstrates a single linear direction mediates refusal in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. That claim rests only on logged baseline vs. steered examples, with no rates, no addition test and no capability check.
record.recipe_differences: The repository estimates a normalized harmful-minus-safe direction from last-token activations and applies runtime projection subtraction at selected layers. It does not report the original all-layer-and-position ablation. This is a hands-on project-school exploration based on the cited work, not a README-identified formal replication.
record.method_sensitivity: The README identifies layers 14, 18, 22, and 26 as probed, and says clear separation appears at layers 18–26. It does not report layer-specific behavioral outcomes in the supplied text.

fits_no_version.finding: Last-token activations for AdvBench vs. Alpaca prompts separate linearly in PCA/UMAP at layers 18–26 but not clearly at layer 14.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Harmful and harmless instructions become linearly separable in middle-to-late layers.

record.problems: The reported steering result is qualitative, with no stated prompt count, refusal rate, uncertainty, or capability evaluation. The README points to a steering log and plots, but their contents are not supplied here; the code was not read or run.
record.rows_left_out: No separately quantified layer-specific outcomes are stated in the supplied README text. The listed plot and log artifact contents were unavailable in the supplied text, so no further results were extracted from them.

record.verdict_notes: This is a project-school exploration with 0 stars, not peer reviewed. The steering log and code were not read. The verdict rests on a single README sentence and should carry little weight.
